notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 Live - Steamdeck Verified + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Got everything fully working on Steamdeck and correct input prompts for tutorial popups
Fixed green edge on shadows on mac builds
Fixed Steam achievements not being unlocked

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 Released
notes.notes:
Mod Stuff:

 Steam workshop is setup! Untested so far though so I expect things to not work right for a bit.
 updated mod loader to v6 (Breaking changes: https://github.com/GodotModding/godot-mod-loader/wiki/Breaking-Changes)


Game Changes:

 made all unique zombie traits have equal chance of appearing (fixing bubble shield never appearing)
 reduced vampirism heal amount
 made biomasses created by hibernation upgrade always spawn enemies
 made so doors cannot be closed in endemic mode
 changed color of exit buttons
 made spectral zombie on spikr boss not take thorns damage
 made revolver drum not turn on double pack effect working
 made zombies not block light after dying
 decreased rat reaction time to be the same as regular game
 fixed two levels not being playable due to shadow errors
 improved gun tutorial level
 fixed bug where doors that start open still block light
 fixed bug where some upgrades selected at start of game would still appear in shops later
 fixed ammo containers sometimes spawning in walls
 fixed bug where corpse traps on fire heal player through vampirism after dying
 fixed bug where ratr will continue attacking you after being killed by thorns
 fixed Misslr missile hit positions being squished weirdly sometimes

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Endemic Mode, Mod Support, Optimizations
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Major Things:

Endemic Mode! New roguelike mode with procgen levels, an upgrade system, 5 new bosses, and new achievements
Mod Support! Info on how to make mods here: https://github.com/GodotModding/godot-mod-loader/wiki/ Complete rework of shadow system with massively improved performance


Other Stuff:

fixed bullets sometimes going through enemies at point-blank range
added tip popup suggesting to load older save if player dies multiple times without making progress
added notice to splash screen explaining how to fix the splash screen freeze bug
added revolver bullets to shotgun swarm room (for those doing revolver-only challenges)
fixed crosshair getting stuck on dead bodies sometimes


I'm going to continue working on this game mode on and off over the next few months so feel free to suggest things you would like to see. I'm reading all the community discussions about it.

notes.notes: Fixed save icons showing hard mode icon even on normal modes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Mac crash fix, Hard Mode, Controller Support
notes.notes:
added hard mode
added achievement for completing hard mode
added achievement for getting all inventory upgrades
added controller support
fixed macbook crash bug
fixed green outlines on shadows on macs
fixed enemies trying to move around corpse traps
improved pipe audio proximity volume
fixed pravi voice still playing if you skip and go to the next level
increased grab area for revolver
fixed Exterminator achievement not completing
replaced toggle buttons with one-time buttons in a couple levels to make them less confusing


NOTE FOR MAC USERS:
There's a weird bug where you have to double-click to use the left mouse button. I've made a post on how to fix this: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2124780/discussions/0/4811561152911917218/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES

Made flares smaller (down from 14 to 10 slots)
Made biomass nodes on fire set enemies they spawn on fire
Made biomass boss lines take longer to grow in
Made biomass lines not spawn on existing lines (this was resulting in hordes of enemies being spawned in the boss fight)
Increased time between telehunter teleports from 3 to 5 seconds
Fixed broken subtitles on dying guard scene

Also I'm working on a hard mode, will be done by the end of the week for sure

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes

Added subtitles (can be toggled in settings)
fixed bug where voice over kept playing after loading a save mid cutscene 
fixed bug where zombies would get stuck on a shot crossbow bolt
Added fan translation support (guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2881137110)

Also, a lot of people with macs have reported issues with not being able to run the game. I'm ordering a mac so I can debug this, but in the mean-time I'll try borrowing a friend's over the weekend to try getting this fixed, sorry about that.
